performance.verdict: $502 spent across 28 days; zero leads confirmed — attribution or conversion path is broken.

findings.text: Zero leads recorded across all 28 days despite $502.16 Google spend and 114 clicks — conversion tracking or lead path is structurally broken, not a spend problem.
5 SOW milestones overdue (oldest Jul 20): GHL Build gaps, End-to-End Stack Re-Test ⛔, Paid Landing Pages, and UGC Batch — all blockers to lead flow and attribution.
GBP actions dropped -100% in last 7 days (41 actions prior period, now 0) — organic call and direction volume has gone dark simultaneously with paid lead drought.
3-day spend signal (Sep 4–6): $14.86 + $10.78 + $8.82 = $34.46 vs prior 3 days (Sep 1–3): $12.86 + $20.51 + $19.52 = $52.89 — spend decelerating with zero leads at any level.
GHL shows 111 opportunities created with $0 value and 0 won — pipeline exists but no dollar amounts or lead sources mapped; intake path field-mapping unverified per SOW.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion action and landing page form end-to-end — zero leads from 114 clicks over 28 days confirms a broken path, not ad underperformance.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $502.16 over 28 days and generated 114 clicks but zero recorded leads or GA4 conversions — the conversion action or post-click form is broken. Audit the Google Ads conversion tag, the landing page form submission event, and the GHL lead intake webhook in sequence. Success is confirmed when at least one test lead fires through all three and appears in GHL with full field mapping. Complete this audit by 2026-09-10.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget scaling until conversion path is verified — spending more at $0 CPL is confirmed waste. Re-check after fix lands Sep 10.
suggestions.monday_update: With zero leads recorded against $502.16 spend and 5 overdue SOW milestones including the End-to-End Stack Re-Test, scaling any campaign now would accelerate waste. No budget changes are recommended this cycle. Re-evaluate on 2026-09-10 once the conversion tracking audit (S1) and stack re-test results are in hand.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP -100% drop: check listing status, ownership, and whether the profile was suspended or edited, as 41 actions went to 0 this week.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell from 41 to 0 in the last 7 days — a -100% drop that cuts the only active organic lead signal. Log into Google Business Profile and check for a suspension notice, a pending verification request, or a recent edit that triggered re-review. Success is confirmed when actions resume above 5 per week. Check status by 2026-09-10.
